idea-plugin.name: Anvil
idea-plugin.description:
Run and inspect Minecraft server test environments defined with Anvil, a testing framework for Minecraft Java Edition servers, proxies, and simulated players.

Anvil finds the scenario definitions in your Gradle project and lists them in the Anvil tool window. Start a whole environment or a single server or proxy, then follow it in a session tab:

  • Environment: live status, join address, workspaces, and per-process start, stop, and restart
  • Console: merged or per-process output with ANSI colors, and commands sent to one process
  • Players: simulated players with actions and observations contributed by their capabilities

The plugin also manages project and global accounts and account pools, including browser sign-in, and can save a scenario or a single process as a Run Configuration.

Requirements

  • A Gradle project that applies the me.whereareiam.anvil Gradle plugin, at an Anvil version matching this plugin
  • Java 21 or newer for the project runtime

Open View | Tool Windows | Anvil to begin, and configure preferences in Settings | Tools | Anvil. See the IntelliJ IDEA guide for setup and usage.

Limitations

Only Gradle projects are supported. One environment runs per IntelliJ project at a time, and processes cannot be debugged from the IDE.

Anvil is not an official Minecraft product and is not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
